title.narrative: Reformed Elections for Enhanced Democracy and Inclusion (REDI) Programme
Stärkande av medborgarnas förtroende och tillit till Kenyas valprocesser

description.narrative: Reformed Elections for Enhanced Democracy and Inclusion (REDI) is a three-year democracy and elections support programme implemented between December 2025 and December 2028, with a grant of up to SEK 21 million, and implemented by Act Change Transform (Act!) following a competitive Expression of Interest process involving 110 local organisations. The programme strengthens democratic governance through civic education, electoral integrity, and inclusive participation, with a focus on youth and first-time voters, women and marginalized groups, civil society, and democratic institutions, contributing to increased citizen participation and more free, fair, and credible elections

Reformed Elections for Enhanced Democracy and Inclusion (REDI) är ett treårigt program för demokrati- och valstöd som genomförs mellan december 2025 och december 2028 med ett bidrag på upp till 21 miljoner svenska kronor, och implementeras av Act Change Transform (Act!) efter en konkurrensutsatt Expression of Interest-process med 110 lokala organisationer. Programmet stärker demokratisk styrning genom medborgarutbildning, valens integritet och inkluderande deltagande, med fokus på unga och förstagångsväljare, kvinnor och marginaliserade grupper, civilsamhället och demokratiska institutioner, och bidrar till ökat medborgardeltagande samt mer fria, rättvisa och trovärdiga val.

The objectives of the Reformed Elections for Enhanced Democracy and Inclusion (REDI) programme are as follows:
Impact Level
To contribute to a stable and inclusive Kenya with trusted democratic institutions and citizens enjoying their rights
Outcome 1: National cohesion & Stability maintained
The intermediate results under this outcome are:
i) Enhanced citizens resilience to electoral violence and conflict; and
ii) Strengthened Early Warning and Early Response systems.
Outcome 2: Electoral institutions and stakeholder engagement structures strengthened
The key intermediate results under this outcome are:
i) Consensus building for election stakeholders;
ii) Effective elections planning, coordination, and management;
iii) Enhanced strategic communications; and
iv) key electoral reforms implemented
Outcome 3: Citizens participation in the 2027 elections enhanced
The intermediate results under this outcome are:
i) Enhanced issue-based and citizen-led voter and civic education;
ii) Increased mobilisation for the participation of women, persons with disabilities, young people, and other marginalised groups as voters and candidates; and
iii) Responsive and accountable electoral institutions.
Outcome 4: Elections monitoring and observation strengthened
The intermediate results under this outcome are:
i) Enhanced media and civic space;
ii) Strengthened citizen-led Human Rights Watch and reporting;
iii) Strengthened domestic elections observation and monitoring.
Theory of Change
The proposed ToC for the REDI programme is:
IF before, during and after the 2027 elections national cohesion and stability are maintained; AND IF electoral institutions and stakeholder engagement structures are strengthened; AND IF citizens participation in the 2027 elections is enhanced; AND IF elections monitoring and observation is strengthened, THEN there will be a stable and inclusive Kenya with trusted democratic and oversight institutions and citizens enjoying their rights.
ASSUMING THAT the Government will partner and collaborate with civil society and local communities to prevent electoral conflict, political leaders will be committed to peaceful elections, citizens will see participation in democratic processes as a pathway to solving the countrys leadership and governance challenges, political parties will be committed to internal democracy and inclusion, the state will respect civic space and human rights, Parliament will be committed to electoral reforms and financing of IEBC and digital and technology approaches will enhance access to information and influence participation of citizens.
